## Developer Guide

### Criteria

:exclamation:| Reminder that the following criteria applies to *innersource contributions* (not necessarily intra-team work). Please include an additional section below for non-innersource contributions if needed
:-|:-

#### General enhancement/contribution criteria

Please refer to [the Criteria section of the `CONTRIBUTING.md` file within .github](https://github.com/8451LLC/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#criteria) for more detail on the general requirements for both
enhancement proposals and contribution requests.

#### Project specific criteria

> Please include any relevant additional criteria not defined in base .github CONTRIBUTING.md file here

### Contribution process

Please refer to [the 'Contribution process' section of the the `CONTRIBUTING.md` file within .github](https://github.com/8451LLC/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-process)
for more detail on the process required to get a contribution merged into a project branch (creating an enhancement issue request -> creating a contribution pull request).

> If you have additional project-specific steps please include/reference them here

### Additional quickstart instructions

> If you have any quickstart instructions to get up and running quickly (in a Wiki, README, or other source) please include/reference them here


## Project-specific Contribution Guidelines

> Many guidelines are already stated in [this wiki page](https://github.com/8451LLC/software-delivery-system/wiki/Additional-Contribution-Guidelines),
including leveraging forking as the primary mechanism for contribution. If you have any additional preferences, please include them here
